labels.tsvNames: Tab separated with a header row

notes.parquet: Columnar, typed, and the fastest of these to load.
notes.native: What the server itself writes. No conversion at either end.

warnings.unnamed: {format} carries no column names, so the values land in the table's column ORDER. A file whose columns are in another order fills the wrong ones, and nothing about that is an error.
warnings.guessed: The format was read off the file's name, not its contents. If it is wrong the load refuses, usually on the first row.
warnings.compressed: The file is sent compressed and the server expands it as it arrives, so nothing is written to this computer.
warnings.noTransaction: An INSERT is not inside a transaction. A load that fails part way through leaves the rows it had already written, and running it again adds them a second time.

describe.byName: Read as {format} and matched to {name} by column name.
describe.byPosition: Read as {format} and matched to {name} by column position.
